name: event_id
description: UUID event ID for this funnel step. Primary key.

name: checkout_id
description: MongoDB ObjectId of the checkout/abandoned cart document

name: user_id
description: MongoDB ObjectId of the authenticated user (null for anonymous)

name: anonymous_id
description: Anonymous identifier for guest checkout tracking

name: session_id
description: Session ID for linking funnel steps to a session

name: step
description: Funnel step name: cart | shipping | payment | review | complete

name: step_time
description: Timestamp when the user entered this step. Partition field.

name: time_in_step_seconds
description: Time spent on this step before proceeding or dropping off (seconds)

name: proceeded
description: True if user moved to the next step; false if they dropped off

name: cart_value
description: Total cart value at the time of this step

name: item_count
description: Number of items in cart at the time of this step

name: has_discount
description: True if a discount code was applied at the time of this step

name: source
description: Attribution source at the time of checkout initiation

name: confidence_level
description: Attribution confidence level for this checkout session
